description:
Microsoft Dynamics Analyst
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a Microsoft Dynamics Analyst for a contract opportunity in Milwaukee WI.
 

 Microsoft Dynamics Analyst Job Details
 

 The ideal candidate will be an experienced Microsoft Dynamics CRM Developer/Analyst with .net background . The person will work closely with Business Process Owners and IT resources in defining and implementing requirements specific to Partner Relationship Management and supporting post go-live systems. Partner Relationship Management will implement CRM Dynamics On-Line replacing four existing Channel-based systems. IT commitments include integrations with SAP, security platforms, SharePoint and our Office 365 implementation. Experience in the entire Dynamics CRM Dynamics technology stack or CRM On-line is ideal.. The candidate should be proficient in using Microsoft CRM Dynamics development tools. In addition to CRM Dynamics, the candidate will be expected to learn and support the ADX Portal that support the CRM Dynamics User Interface.

 Microsoft Dynamics Analyst Mandatory Skills
 

 5+ years of related experience.
 Broad based background in IT applications and infrastructure technology.
 Demonstrated technical and analyst skills on prior Microsoft CRM Dynamics Projects and ideally Microsoft CRM On-line Projects.
 Has an advanced technical understanding of Microsoft CRM Dynamics and Microsoft CRM On-Line.
 Experience administering CRM Dynamics Environments. Experience with global implementations preferred.
 Customization Custom workflow Provisioning/Provisioning tools Data Integration
 Microsoft CRM Dynamics 2015 or Microsoft CRM Dynamics On-Line configuration and development skills.
 .Net, C#, and Java Script experience.
 Knowledge of ADX Portal or ability to pick up technical skills quickly allowing them to learn how to configure this solution Knowledge of Microsoft SharePoint.
 Bachelors in Computer Science or Management Information Systems or related experience.

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
